title: Beta 0.2 is slowly approaching for my post-apocalyptic RPG
author: No_Piano_1857
selftext:
I’m currently preparing Beta 0.2 for Arkansas 2125, my solo-developed post-apocalyptic turn-based RPG.

This update includes visual improvements, UI changes, bug fixes, and additional world details.

The game is inspired by classic Fallout-style RPGs and focuses on atmosphere, exploration, and tactical combat.

Beta 0.2 is coming soon.

If anyone is curious, Arkansas 2125 is available in Early Access on Steam.

comments.author: bloomt1990
comments.body: Looks like someone played fallout 1 and 2

replies.author: No_Piano_1857
replies.body: Yes, yes, the inspiration is there. I really like the old Fallouts. I heard that there's a group of people who prefer the old Fallouts over Fallout 3.

replies.author: clashmar
replies.body: I’m one of them! This looks cool, I started a pixel art fallout 1+2 in space years ago but isometric pixel art is hard work for a non-artist. Good luck with the project

comments.author: kal101246
comments.body: How did you go about creating the art assets for the game? i'm digging the style and would love to learn more

replies.author: No_Piano_1857
replies.body: Models from Sketchfab, some Unity, characters from Fuse. I only use AI for posters and it's chatgpt

replies.author: No_Piano_1857

comments.author: DstnB3
comments.body: How do you do the animations? The most difficult part for ai game dev for me has been getting the animations to look fine.

replies.author: No_Piano_1857
replies.body: I buy animations from Asset Store or, more often, download them from Mixamo. I plan to try out this new AI animation generation system.
